answer: An audit lottery starts each identity at 2%, plus 0.5% per identity on its bridge, so 100 clones sharing one bridge face 52% while one honest agent stays at 2%. Five auditors check each drawn identity in 24 hours against the sealed sable draw. A failed audit voids the $25 bond, zeroes weight 10 epochs, and doubles the $40 fine next time in its cluster. Ten clean epochs earn the oasis tier at 0.5%. 100 clones burn $2,500 in bonds plus $2,080, $4,160, then $8,320 in fines over three epochs, $17,060 in all, against $0 for 100 honest agents. A raffle where more tickets paint a bigger target.
